Q5: How many reruns should one PR get before the pr-merge lane (the CI job that merges approved PRs) stops rerunning?
Context: a rerun is one more pass of both AI reviews on the PR's new head SHA, the commit the PR branch points at; reruns fire on every new head SHA and never block the merge (.work/review-reruns/interview-checklist.md:16-17).
My recommendation: three reruns per PR.
Checked against: ci-status stays the only required check; a review re-runs only when the head SHA changes
Basis: verified, .work/review-reruns/interview-checklist.md:16.
Alternatives:
- (a) No limit. Never skips a review, but a PR pushed often reruns without end.
- (b) One rerun. Cheapest, but a second fix push goes unreviewed.

Q6: Should a force-push that keeps the same tree reset the rerun limit?
Context: a force-push can change the head SHA without changing any file (judgment).
My recommendation: no.
Basis: verified, .work/review-reruns/interview-checklist.md:6.
Alternatives:
- (a) Reset it. Simple to explain, but a rebase-only push spends reruns on unchanged code.
